<a id="architecture"></a>

## Architecture

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| principles | Smallest change at each seam. The reset comparison lives where a rejection becomes a stop (core usage_limit or the daemon's stops), using the existing margin constant and an injected clock, never wall time in tests. The opt-in path reuses the PA path's cold-wake verdict and audit helper; no second guard. The quieting rule and the nudge text must name the same report command, and a test pins the text against the rule. The brief changes cite docs/how instead of restating them. |
| composition_root | crates/daemon/src/pa_watchdog.rs |
| contracts | stop = rejection whose resets_at + LIMIT_WAKE_MARGIN_SECS is in the future, watchdog status: {pas: live only, optins: live only, retired_pas?} |
| seams | crates/core/src/usage_limit.rs latest_active, crates/daemon/src/pa_watchdog.rs stops/on_limit ~385-575, crates/core/src/watchdog.rs opt-in nudge ~430, crates/daemon/src/http/watchdog.rs status ~181, skills/pij/references/prime/pa.md, docs/how/pa-watchdog.md |
